notes: Republican-style two-story river-port authority building (1935) near the Malecón, light blue with white quoins/trim, red tile roof; today seat of the Secretaría de Cultura. photo-1: corner view from the street side showing both flanks. photo-2: frontal view from the riverfront promenade (Malecón) side with palms in foreground. photo-3: panorama showing the riverside setting of the building along the water.
